A marquee styleset for geom_mark_*()

Source: R/mark_label.R
mark_style.Rd

This function constructs stylesets with defaults appropriate for the text boxes in the geom_mark_*() family of geoms.

Usage

mark_style(
  base_size = 10,
  background = "white",
  color = "black",
  header_color = color,
  lineheight = 1,
  margin = marquee::trbl(grid::unit(2, "mm")),
  ...
)

Arguments

base_size

The base size for the text (depending on the style, some text may be larger, e.g. headings)

background

The background color of the textbox

color

The text color in the textbox

header_color

The text color for headings in the textbox

lineheight

The base lineheight for the text in the textbox

margin

The margin around the text in the textbox

...

Further arguments to pass on to marquee::classic_style()

Value

A marquee style_set object with a length corresponding to the length of the input
